chunks.title: Profile · Muhammad Huzaifa
chunks.text: Muhammad Huzaifa. Game Designer & Developer. Karachi, Pakistan. Final-year Bachelor of Gaming and Animation student at NED University of Engineering and Technology. Email: huzaifaraees6146@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammadhuzaifa24/.

chunks.title: R.I.S.E
chunks.text: R.I.S.E. Final Year Design Project. AR / VR. An immersive VR rehabilitation and educational support system. Built with Unity and C#, combining hand-tracking gloves with custom visual feedback for interactive learning experiences. Technologies: Unity, C#, VR, Hand-tracking gloves.

chunks.title: AR Tank Trouble
chunks.text: AR Tank Trouble. Augmented reality combat. AR / VR. An AR combat game where the player controls one tank to aim, fire, and destroy enemy targets. Features AR interactions, a 3D battlefield, player controls, and physics-based movement. Technologies: Unity, C#, AR, Physics.

chunks.title: Furious 7
chunks.text: Furious 7. Racing / Action. 3D Games. A racing and action-inspired 3D game project, with contributions to player controls, gameplay mechanics, scene setup, environment interactions, and performance optimization. Technologies: Unity, C#, 3D Game Design.

chunks.title: WADA
chunks.text: WADA. 3D Open-World Action Adventure. 3D Games. An immersive 3D open-world game set in a stylized Arabian environment, featuring dynamic third-person combat systems, exploration mechanics, fluid animations, and custom environmental asset design built in Unity & Blender. Technologies: Unity, C#, Blender, 3D Combat, Open World.

chunks.title: Ambugo
chunks.text: Ambugo. Ambulance management system. Web application. An ambulance management platform with a relational MySQL database, PHP-backed booking modules, dynamic forms, and organization records for services including Chhipa and Edhi. Technologies: MySQL, PHP, JavaScript, HTML / CSS.

chunks.title: The Kitchen Carnage
chunks.text: The Kitchen Carnage. Pre-production / Story development. Game Development. Contributed to the pre-production of a kitchen-themed action game: concept development, story creation, character planning, environmental ideas, and level progression. Technologies: Game Concept, Story Development, Level Planning.

chunks.title: The Signal Shutdown
chunks.text: The Signal Shutdown. Survival / GameCon runner-up. 3D Games. A survival game featuring interactive player systems, environment design, story progression, and level mechanics. Presented with my team at GameCon, earning a runner-up position. Technologies: Unity, C#, Gameplay Systems.

chunks.title: Technical skills
chunks.text: # Skills and specialization Muhammad Huzaifa specializes in 3D graphics, VR/AR development, AI integration, and web applications. 3D Modeling: Blender, custom avatars, glTF/GLB. VR and Game Engines: Unity, C#, Unreal Engine, C++, AR/VR, gameplay systems, level development, testing, and optimization. Web Development: React, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. AI and Backend: Python, RAG, MCP, Hugging Face, PHP, MySQL. Visual design: Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. Soft skills: creative thinking, communication, team collaboration, time management, and problem solving.
